name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.70-beta “Paris” (build 79): LitArbi for Word, links that travel, SharePoint.
• Update Exhibits from Brief no longer freezes LitArbi: a progress window shows each step with Stop, LitArbi for Word stays connected, only the citations that change are rewritten, and the cursor goes back where it was.
• A memorandum saved under a new name is recognised as a new version of the earlier one; Update asks once if it was filed with it by mistake.
• LitArbi for Word, from Microsoft's store: Settings ▸ Add-ins ▸ LitArbi for Word connects it to LitArbi on this PC. Where your Word runs it in full, LitArbi offers once to switch from the ribbon template; its pane can switch between your matters (Settings ▸ LitArbi on this computer).
• Links that travel: a citation links to its exhibit in the matter (litarbi://cite), so it opens at the cited page wherever the matter is — in a colleague's copy and in a bundle too.
• Date ranges: type "1–5 April 2021", "March–April 2021" or "2019–2021" as an exhibit's date; lists, citations and the statement of facts write them in the matter's language.
• Formatting in citation templates: *bold*, _italic_ and ++underline++ (Settings ▸ Citation).
• Exhibit files in SharePoint or a synced folder: Settings ▸ Storage — sign in with Microsoft 365 and choose a library, or pick a folder that OneDrive or another app keeps in sync.
Windows 10 (1809) or later, x64 or ARM64.
